title: Prayag Private I.T.I. v. State of U.P.
coram: Sanjay Yadav, A.C.J. and Prakash Padia, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner left to Supply Code 2005 remedy.
headnote: Where the petitioner admittedly has a remedy under the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (as amended on 10 August 2018) for a recovery certificate, connection of supply, installment facility and surcharge exemption, the High Court will not entertain the writ and will leave the petitioner to that Code remedy.
facts: Prayag Private I.T.I. filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court seeking to quash a recovery certificate dated 6 November 2019 for Rs. 3,80,000 plus recovery charges and interest, a mandamus to connect electricity supply to the institute at once, a direction that respondents receive the correct dues in easy installments with surcharge exemption, and a restraint against harassment. The Division Bench heard the matter by video conferencing.

holding_units.holding: A writ seeking quashing of a recovery certificate, mandamus for electricity connection, installment facility and surcharge exemption is not entertained where the petitioner has a remedy under the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (as amended on 10 August 2018); the petitioner is left to avail that Code remedy.

principle_tags.application: The Bench declined writ indulgence because the petitioner admittedly had a remedy under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as amended on 10 August 2018, and disposed of the petition by leaving the petitioner to that remedy without deciding the recovery, connection or installment prayers.

not_decided.point: Validity of the recovery certificate dated 06.11.2019 and the claimed arrears, recovery charges and interest
not_decided.note: Left to the petitioner's remedy under the Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Entitlement to connection of supply, installment facility, surcharge exemption, and restraint against harassment
